CODD.Settings.Configuration.Name: Curse Configuration
CODD.Settings.Configuration.Label: Configure victims
CODD.Settings.Configuration.Hint: Choose cursed characters and the paladin whose Aura of Protection may aid them.
CODD.Settings.SaveDC.Name: Curse saving throw DC
CODD.Settings.SaveDC.Hint: The DC of the saving throw against the attacked ability.
CODD.Settings.PaladinChance.Name: Paladin proximity chance (out of 20)
CODD.Settings.PaladinChance.Hint: The victim is near the paladin when 1d20 is equal to or lower than this value. 10 means a 10/20 chance.
CODD.Settings.FallbackAuraBonus.Name: Fallback Aura of Protection bonus
CODD.Settings.FallbackAuraBonus.Hint: Used when the proximity check succeeds but no paladin actor can be found. A configured paladin uses their current Charisma modifier instead.
CODD.Settings.IntervalDays.Name: Days between curse attacks
CODD.Settings.IntervalDays.Hint: How many Simple Calendar days pass between attacks. Changing this resets the next attack date.
CODD.Settings.AbilityLossFormula.Name: Ability score loss
CODD.Settings.AbilityLossFormula.Hint: A roll formula for ability score loss after a failed save, for example 1d4 or 2.
CODD.Config.Title: Curse of Death and Despair
CODD.Config.VictimsHint: Every selected character receives a separate chat card on each scheduled curse day. Uncheck a character after their curse is removed.
CODD.Config.PaladinHint: When nearby, the chosen paladin's current Charisma modifier is temporarily added to the curse saving throw. Automatic mode chooses the detected paladin with the highest modifier.
CODD.Config.RemoveEffectsConfirm: Remove all ability-drain effects managed by this module from the victims currently checked in this window? Their base ability scores will be restored.
CODD.Card.Title: Curse of Death and Despair
CODD.Card.PendingText: The curse coils around {actor}, seeking another piece of their life.
CODD.Card.Determining: The curse is searching for weakness…
CODD.Card.SuccessDetail: The result of {total} meets DC {dc}. The victim resists the drain.
CODD.Card.FailureDetail: The result of {total} fails DC {dc}. The victim loses {loss} {ability} and has {remaining} remaining.
CODD.Card.FailureCappedDetail: The result of {total} fails DC {dc}. The loss roll was {rolled}, but only {loss} {ability} could be drained. {remaining} remains.
CODD.Card.DeathThreshold: {actor}'s {ability} has reached 0. The curse has reached its lethal threshold.
CODD.Rolls.PaladinProximity: {actor}: Is the paladin nearby? Success on {target}/20 or lower.
CODD.Rolls.AbilityTarget: {actor}: Which ability does the curse attack?
CODD.Rolls.AbilityLoss: {actor}: Ability score drained by the curse.
CODD.Effect.DrainName: Curse of Death and Despair — Ability Drain
CODD.Notifications.MissedCyclesCapped: More than 20 curse cycles were skipped. Only the first 20 were created.
CODD.Notifications.CalendarError: The curse schedule could not be processed. Check the console for details.
CODD.Notifications.InvalidLossFormula: The formula "{formula}" is invalid. The module used 1d4 instead.
CODD.Notifications.SaveCancelled: The saving throw was cancelled. The chat-card button is available again.
CODD.Notifications.ActionError: The curse action failed. Check the console for details.
CODD.Notifications.ScheduleReset: The curse schedule has been reset from the current calendar day.
CODD.Notifications.NotOwner: Only the victim's owner or a GM can use this button.
CODD.Notifications.WrongSystem: Curse of Death and Despair requires the dnd5e game system.
CODD.Notifications.CalendarMissing: Curse of Death and Despair requires Simple Calendar Reborn to be active.
